datasets.name: 0240fd49
datasets.displayName: Airbnb Test Set Price Prediction Results Dataset
queryLines:
SELECT city, room_type, neighbourhood_cleansed AS neighbourhood, accommodates,
       price, model_pred, baseline_pred, error, abs_error
FROM airbnb.gold.price_predictions
WHERE split = 'test' AND in_scope = true;

datasets.name: 7eb25cda
datasets.displayName: Airbnb City Room Type Price Prediction Errors Summary
queryLines:
SELECT city, room_type, COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(AVG(abs_error), 1) AS mae, ROUND(AVG(error), 1) AS bias
FROM airbnb.gold.price_predictions
WHERE split = 'test' AND in_scope = true
GROUP BY city, room_type;

datasets.name: 91adb18a
datasets.displayName: City Neighborhood Airbnb Listings and Median Prices Summary
queryLines:
WITH n AS (
  SELECT city, neighbourhood_cleansed AS neighbourhood,
         COUNT(*) AS listings,
         ROUND(PERCENTILE(price, 0.5), 0) AS median_price
  FROM airbnb.gold.price_predictions
  WHERE in_scope = true
  GROUP BY city, neighbourhood_cleansed
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
), r AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY median_price DESC) AS rn_top,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY median_price ASC) AS rn_bottom
  FROM n
)
SELECT city, neighbourhood, listings, median_price,
       CASE WHEN rn_top <= 5 THEN 'Most expensive' ELSE 'Cheapest' END AS group_label
FROM r
WHERE rn_top <= 5 OR rn_bottom <= 5;

datasets.name: 77888b5c
datasets.displayName: City Room Type Median Price and Listings Summary
queryLines:
SELECT city, room_type,
       ROUND(PERCENTILE(price, 0.5), 0) AS median_price,
       COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM airbnb.gold.price_predictions
WHERE in_scope = true
GROUP BY city, room_type
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30;

datasets.name: cb0d4d7d
datasets.displayName: Sydney Melbourne Median Price Comparison Gap
queryLines:
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN city = 'sydney' THEN median_price END) AS sydney_median,
  MAX(CASE WHEN city = 'melbourne' THEN median_price END) AS melbourne_median,
  ROUND(100 * (
    MAX(CASE WHEN city = 'sydney' THEN median_price END) /
    MAX(CASE WHEN city = 'melbourne' THEN median_price END) - 1), 0) AS gap_pct
FROM airbnb.gold.city_summary
WHERE city IN ('sydney', 'melbourne');

datasets.name: 420a55af
datasets.displayName: City Model Test Metrics for Sydney and Melbourne
queryLines:
SELECT
  city,
  model,
  CONCAT(city, ' ', model) AS series,
  ROUND(mae, 0) AS mae
FROM airbnb.gold.model_metrics
WHERE stage = 'test' AND city IN ('sydney', 'melbourne');

datasets.name: f39c1cf9
datasets.displayName: Airbnb City Listings Overview for Sydney and Melbourne
queryLines:
SELECT
  city,
  listings,
  hosts,
  ROUND(listings / hosts, 1) AS listings_per_host,
  pct_entire_home,
  ROUND(avg_availability_365, 0) AS avg_availability_365,
  ROUND(avg_review_score, 2) AS avg_review_score,
  median_price
FROM airbnb.gold.city_summary
WHERE city IN ('sydney', 'melbourne');

datasets.name: 7884f2f4
datasets.displayName: Airbnb City Room Type Price Prediction Errors Summary
queryLines:
SELECT city, room_type,
       ROUND(AVG(error), 0) AS bias,
       ROUND(AVG(abs_error), 0) AS mae,
       COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM airbnb.gold.price_predictions
WHERE in_scope = true AND split IN ('test', 'new_city')
GROUP BY city, room_type
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30;

datasets.name: 35282aff
datasets.displayName: Airbnb Test Set Filtered Price And Model Predictions
queryLines:
SELECT city, price, model_pred
FROM airbnb.gold.price_predictions
WHERE split = 'test' AND in_scope = true AND price <= 1000
  AND pmod(hash(listing_id), 5) = 0;

datasets.name: 3e8809a4
datasets.displayName: Model Error Metrics for Sydney Melbourne and Brisbane
queryLines:
SELECT city, model, ROUND(mae, 1) AS mae
FROM airbnb.gold.model_metrics
WHERE (city IN ('sydney', 'melbourne') AND stage = 'test')
   OR (city = 'brisbane' AND stage = 'first_run');

datasets.name: fa0d9933
datasets.displayName: Top Airbnb Listings With Lowest Prediction Errors
queryLines:
SELECT listing_id, city, room_type, neighbourhood_cleansed, price,
       ROUND(model_pred, 0) AS model_pred, ROUND(error, 0) AS error
FROM airbnb.gold.price_predictions
WHERE split = 'test' AND in_scope = true
ORDER BY error ASC
LIMIT 10;

datasets.name: 9e587eba
datasets.displayName: City Price Buckets With Average Prediction Errors
queryLines:
SELECT city,
       CAST(FLOOR(price / 100) * 100 AS INT) AS price_from,
       ROUND(AVG(error), 0) AS avg_error,
       COUNT(*) AS listings
FROM airbnb.gold.price_predictions
WHERE in_scope = true AND split IN ('test', 'new_city') AND price < 1500
GROUP BY city, CAST(FLOOR(price / 100) * 100 AS INT)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30;
